description: Buying-intent category queries for hotels, resorts, restaurants and travel destinations. No brand names: the brand under test either appears in the answer or it does not.

prompts.text: What's the best hotel in Lisbon for a family with two young kids?
Which boutique hotels in Kyoto are walkable to the main sights?
Where should I stay in Rome for a first visit on a mid-range budget?
What are the best beach resorts in Mexico for couples that include meals?
Which hotels near a major airport offer a free shuttle and late check-out?
What are the best restaurants for a group dinner of ten in Chicago?
Which small hotels in the Scottish Highlands have good reviews from hikers?
What's the best area to stay in Tokyo for someone who doesn't speak Japanese?
Which all-inclusive resorts in the Caribbean are best for families with teenagers?
Where can I find pet-friendly hotels on the California coast?
What are the best bed and breakfasts in Vermont for a fall weekend?
Which hotels in Paris are quiet but still close to the metro?
What's the best vacation rental area in Barcelona for a group of six?
Which ski resorts in the Alps are best for beginners on a budget?
What are the best hotels for a business trip in Singapore under $250 a night?
Which spa hotels in Iceland are worth the price?
What should I look for in a hotel for a family reunion of 25 people?
Which travel destinations are best for a relaxing week in October?

brandsNote: Lexicon for competitor extraction. Empty: no lexicon has been built for this vertical yet, and no brand names are invented here. A name matches case-insensitively at word boundaries, using the name plus any aliases. Entries marked ambiguous are common English words and only count in a name-like position (bold, a heading or a list-item label).
